about: GTA VI regions on our census maps: outlines, cameras, routes and named places, in leonida.jpg pixels (paths_vc: vice-city.jpg pixels). Generated in the lab (mapdemo/tools/export_regions.py) from US Census TIGER/Line data; the skill only reads it. The game shows six regions; two are north of our map.
credit: Map data: US Census Bureau TIGER/Line (public domain).

regions.name: Vice City
regions.title: VICE CITY
regions.real: Miami: downtown, Little Havana, Miami Beach and the urban east of Miami-Dade
regions.basis: Rockstar's own text names Ocean Beach, Little Cuba and VC Port; the trailers show the Miami Beach skyline
regions.official: We're a long way from the '80s, but Vice City is still the sun and fun capital of America.

regions.name: Leonida Keys
regions.title: LEONIDA KEYS
regions.real: The Florida Keys, from Key Largo to Key West
regions.basis: Rockstar calls it a tropical archipelago; Jason works there for drug runners (official character text)
regions.official: Life in this tropical archipelago isn't flashy but it's easy.

regions.name: Grassrivers
regions.title: GRASSRIVERS
regions.real: The Everglades: Everglades National Park and Big Cypress
regions.basis: Rockstar's text: a primordial expanse of gators and mangroves
regions.official: You never know what lies beneath the surface of this primordial expanse.

regions.name: Ambrosia
regions.title: AMBROSIA
regions.real: The sugar towns south of Lake Okeechobee: Clewiston, South Bay, Belle Glade, Pahokee (a fan match)
regions.basis: Rockstar's text: 'In the heart of Leonida', the Allied Crystal sugar refinery. The real twin is a fan match, not Rockstar's word
regions.official: In the heart of Leonida, American industry and old school values still reign supreme.

regions.name: Port Gellhorn
regions.title: PORT GELLHORN
regions.real: The Florida Panhandle Gulf coast, around Panama City (a fan match)
regions.basis: Rockstar's text: a once-popular vacation spot of cheap motels and shut-down attractions. Rockstar studied Panama City (Game Informer). Off our map (north of 27.25 N)
regions.official: Cheap motels, shut-down attractions, and empty strip malls won't bring the tourists back.

regions.name: Mount Kalaga
regions.title: MOUNT KALAGA
regions.real: North Florida's forests against the state line (a fan match; the mountain is the game's own)
regions.basis: Rockstar's text: a national landmark up against the state's northern border. Off our map (north of 27.25 N)
regions.official: A national landmark up against the state's northern border, Mount Kalaga offers prime hunting, fishing, and off-road trails.
